info.title: PokeDoku-NX
info.author: Terremotixx
info.description: A 3x3 Pokémon grid puzzle game for Ninte
info.details:
PokeDoku-NX is a native Nintendo Switch homebrew puzzle game inspired by PokeDoku. Solve 3x3 Pokémon grids using 1,213 Pokémon and forms across 76 categories, including types, regions, evolutions, moves, abilities, Mega Evolutions, Gigantamax forms and regional forms.

Features English and Spanish localization with automatic system-language detection, touchscreen and physical controls, localized Pokémon names, search by name or National Pokédex number, configurable rules, timer, Unlimited PP mode, Soft Lock Guard, sound effects and shuffled background music.

Custom OGG and MP3 music is supported from /switch/PokeDoku-NX/music/.

The project is free, non-commercial and open source under the MIT License.
